# infrawrench_sso_group_role_mapping (Resource)

Members of one identity-provider directory group get one Infrawrench role.

Mappings are applied on every directory sync and at each sign-in, to members the directory provisioned or linked. They are evaluated in `position` order and the first match wins; a member in no mapped group gets `infrawrench_sso_settings.default_role_id`. Owners are never changed by the directory.

Two server-side rules make a mapping safe to hand to whoever manages the directory: it can never target the owner role, and the credential creating or changing it must itself hold every permission the role grants. Look the group up by name with the `infrawrench_sso_directory_groups` data source rather than copying its id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "infrawrench_sso_directory_groups" "all" {}

locals {
  groups = { for g in data.infrawrench_sso_directory_groups.all.groups : g.name => g.id }
}

resource "infrawrench_role" "platform" {
  name        = "Platform"
  permissions = ["accounts:*", "resources:*", "deployments:*"]
}

# Evaluated lowest position first; the first group a member is in wins.
resource "infrawrench_sso_group_role_mapping" "platform" {
  directory_group_id = local.groups["Platform engineers"]
  role_id            = infrawrench_role.platform.id
  position           = 0
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `directory_group_id` (String) The WorkOS directory group id (`directory_group_…`). Changing it replaces the mapping.
- `role_id` (String) The role members of the group get. Not the owner role.

### Optional

- `position` (Number) Evaluation order, 0–10000, lowest first. Omit to append after the existing mappings.

### Read-Only

- `group_name` (String) The group's name in the directory, kept in step by Directory Sync.
- `id` (String) Server-assigned mapping id. Use it with `terraform import`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The mapping id is in the --json output of `infrawrench access sso`.
terraform import infrawrench_sso_group_role_mapping.platform 5b6c7d8e-9f0a-1b2c-3d4e-5f6a7b8c9d0e
```
